title: Nạp OCR đã verify qua pipeline hiện có
plan: require explicit --ocr-verified attestation (human compared >=6-word anchors, pages, Dieu, appendix)
apply: call existing ingest-local/profile-ingest with --source-quality ocr; forward --ocr-verified only when operator attested
verify: child pipeline must perform convert/readback/register/NLM gates
rules: Bridge only; no parallel ingest pipeline
OCR is not canonical until child pipeline gates pass
ocr-run must write ocr_manifest.v1 next to sidecar text
ocr-verify must validate manifest hashes before OCR can be used for VBQPPL canonical ingest
VBQPPL OCR without verified manifest is blocked from canonical pipeline

idempotency_contract.journal_key: ocr manifest path + child ingest journal
idempotency_contract.resume_behavior: do not rerun OCR unless source hash changed; rerun bridge apply after ocr-verify manifest_status=verified
idempotency_contract.duplicate_guard: verified OCR manifest + child ingest duplicate guards; VBQPPL blocks canonical ingest if manifest is missing/unverified
idempotency_contract.rollback_hint: delete only local OCR sidecars freely; for Drive/registry/NLM use child pipeline journal/snapshot diff
